approved_row.title: Local coherent acyclicity on sufficiently small polydiscs
approved_row.statement: Assume AC. Let F be coherent analytic on a neighborhood of a point x in C^N. There is a coordinate polydisc W about x such that for every nonempty coordinate polydisc D⊂W and every q>0, H^q(D,F|_D)=0. Scalar sheaf cohomology on such D is computed by its smooth Dolbeault resolution. One can choose W subordinate to a partial finite-rank free resolution of F of length exceeding 2N. The assertion is local in the supplied resolution neighborhood; no untwisted projective Cartan A/B or global Stein generation theorem is asserted.
approved_row.strategy: Write scalar Dolbeault sheaf exactness from the local lemma and smooth-module acyclicity, then global scalar polydisc vanishing. Establish the ordinary sheaf cohomological-dimension bound H^j(D,G)=0 for j>2N for arbitrary abelian sheaves on a polydisc, by explicit finite-order refinements/paracompact Čech comparison, not by misusing a compact-support bound. Choose a partial free resolution longer than 2N on W; dimension shift along its coherent kernels on every D⊂W. No global Cartan A/B.
approved_row.axiom_base: ZF + full AC; record resolutions, countable shrinking/diagonal choices, Baire/Fréchet arguments and supplier-inherited choice uses precisely. No physical premise.
